FN-AR22F7S-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 231
Committee: Transportation and Energy Sponsor: Senator Gerald H. Allen
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/01/2025
REVISED
Senate Bill 231 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Public Service Commission
(PSC) to regulate certain private sewer or wastewater systems that would now be subject to the
jurisdiction of the PSC pursuant to the provisions of this bill by an agency estimated
$1,000,000. These obligations would be offset, in part, by the collection of certain existing
regulatory fees.
